title: No-GPU Visual Observer Roadmap
goal: Allow Odysseus to observe websites and app results visually without a graphics card, using software-rendered screenshots, sampled frames and visual diffs.

slice_queue.goal: Define screenshot evidence metadata, dimensions, hash, viewport, selector focus and redaction policy.
Sample frames from dynamic pages with max duration, max frames and perceptual hash dedupe.
Summarize visual differences between before/after states without storing excessive images.
Bridge screenshots into OCR/caption pipelines when text is only visible as pixels.
Verify screenshot, frame sampling and visual diff on Debian without GPU.

done_definition: Visual checks work on the Debian host without GPU.
Dynamic pages can be observed through sampled frames rather than continuous video.
Screenshots and diffs are bounded, hashed and policy-controlled.
OCR/caption follow-up can be triggered when visual text is not available in DOM.
